notes.review_model: trained on review-level text with star labels; best on the review task (macro-F1 0.6258) but learned star correlations, so it is weak on clean standalone prose (probe 6/8)
notes.sentence_model: trained on sentence-level machine labels; worse at the review task when rolled up (0.5227) but behaves correctly on prose (probe 7/8). Used for the aspect layer, which is sentence-level by construction.
